objective: Introduce the new logo and the story behind it before the calendar starts
caption:
PrimeCode has a new look.

Look at the skyline in the new logo. It's the Amphitheatre at Mont-aux-Sources, the wall of the Drakensberg above Qwaqwa.

The small stroke in the notch is a prime (′). In maths, a′ is read "a prime". It's the Prime in PrimeCode.

And it all sits on a screen, because that's where we do our work: websites, web applications and custom software, built in Phuthaditjhaba.

The company is the same. Only the logo is new, and now it looks like where we're from.

From Tuesday you'll hear from us twice a week. Follow along.
cta: Follow along. We post every Tuesday and Friday.
visualBrief: Typographic carousel on the navy brand background, with the new logo shown large on a white panel (logo-reveal slides). No stock imagery, and never the old helmet logo.
notes: Rebrand announcement added 2026-10-13, outside the workbook: Fri 16 Oct, the Friday before PC-001. Same day: change the Facebook and Instagram profile pictures (assets/brand/export/profile-1080.png) and merge the website's new-logo branch, so people who click through see the new logo. Check that 001's opener ('This page has been quiet') still reads right four days later. Founder: adjust the wording to your own voice.
